description: First clean GitHub Actions bootstrap attempt stopped in the repository test suite because numpy/networkx were absent from the runner. No C run workspace or scientific output was admitted from that attempt.
correction: install declared repository execution dependencies and rerun bootstrap/start_work from the beginning

description: A duplicate startup checkout created C-120-20260807T032553Z locally but its push was rejected because the execution branch had already received the valid governed C-120-20260807T032543Z startup commit. The rejected duplicate was not transplanted or force-pushed.
correction: adopt only the committed 032543Z workspace from current repository truth

description: C-WL-001 and C-WL-002 were initially evaluated interactively before PRE_EXECUTION_LOCK was frozen. Those captures are diagnostic only. Both exact programs must be rerun unchanged after the lock and only the post-lock captures may enter C evidence.
correction: rerun both exact Wolfram calls after lock commit and preserve complete outputs including messages

description: The README-aligned governed closeout attempt passed rfc/director doctor and then stopped before reference or numerical execution because wolfram-record was invoked with the canonical destination output.txt as its source, causing shutil.SameFileError.
correction: copy each already captured post-lock Wolfram output to a temporary path and invoke wolfram-record from that temporary source; rerun the full frozen C matrix from the beginning

description: A governed C execution passed primary gates, independent reconstruction, clean replay, finalization, all evidence promotions and close-run locally, but its closeout commit push was rejected because a concurrent README-protocol workflow-only commit advanced the execution branch after checkout. The unpushed closeout commit was not force-pushed or transplanted.
correction: rerun the complete frozen C matrix from the current branch head and publish only a fast-forward closeout commit

description: Director wolfram-record copied the post-lock C-WL-001 capture successfully, but check_wolfram_output.py failed the required hermitian=True token because its regex did not recognize InputForm association keys escaped as \
inside the captured Out string. The capture itself explicitly contained hermitian -> True.
correction: extend only the checker token delimiter parser to accept quoted or backslash-escaped quoted association keys; leave all frozen expectation fields and required truth values unchanged; rerun the complete frozen C matrix
